label: Push/Pull
description: Moves flat faces in or out along their normal, adding or removing material. Select one or more flat faces, then drag or type a distance. Hold Shift while dragging to push/pull symmetrically: a sketch face about its plane, two parallel faces about their mid-plane, or one face with its mirror counterpart about the origin plane or a datum plane. Alt+click cycles through faces under the cursor.

label: Emboss/Cut along surface
description: Raises or cuts curved faces along their surface normal, for example a pattern drawn on unrolled faces. Select curved faces and type a distance; positive raises, negative cuts.

label: Fillet/Chamfer
description: Rounds or bevels the selected edges. Select edges, then drag outward to round (fillet) or inward to bevel (chamfer), or type a distance.

label: Defeature
description: Removes a feature (a pocket, boss, hole, slot or round) by deleting its faces and extending the neighbouring faces to close the gap. Select one or more faces of the feature; if the faces cannot be closed over, it says why.

label: Remove fillet/chamfer
description: Takes away a rounded or beveled edge and restores the sharp corner. Select the rounded or beveled face.

label: Fill hole / remove boss
description: Fills a hole with material, or cuts a boss back flush. Select the round face of the hole or boss.

label: Resize hole / boss
description: Changes the diameter of a hole or boss, keeping its axis and depth. Select its round face; a diameter of 0 leaves it unchanged.

label: Move hole / boss
description: Moves a hole or boss by the given distances along X, Y and Z. Select its round face.

label: Pattern hole / boss
description: Makes copies of a hole or boss in a straight line. Select its round face, then set the total count and the step between copies along X, Y and Z.

label: Circular pattern
description: Makes copies of a hole or boss around an axis. Select its round face, set the count and the angle to spread them over (360 = full circle); the axis defaults to Z through the origin.

label: Add hole
description: Drills a round hole into a flat face, placed from the face centre. Select one flat face; depth 0 = through.

label: Add counterbore
description: Drills a stepped hole with a wider, flat-bottomed top part for a screw head. Select one flat face; depth 0 = through.

label: Add countersink
description: Drills a hole with a cone-shaped opening for a flat-head screw. Select one flat face; depth 0 = through.

label: Align holes / bosses
description: Lines up holes or bosses so their centres match the first one you selected, along the chosen axis (0 = X, 1 = Y, 2 = Z). Select two or more round faces.

label: Distribute holes / bosses
description: Spaces holes or bosses evenly between the two outermost ones, along the chosen axis (0 = X, 1 = Y, 2 = Z). Select three or more round faces in a row: only the position along the chosen axis changes, so a grid of holes (the four of a bracket base) is spread unevenly; select one row at a time.

label: Add boss
description: Adds a round post standing on a flat face, placed from the face centre. Select one flat face.

label: Add slot
description: Cuts a slot with rounded ends into a flat face, placed from the face centre. Select one flat face; angle turns the slot.

label: Center between faces
description: Centers a hole or boss between two parallel flat faces. Select the round face and the two flat faces, in any order; or the round face and one flat face, and the opposite side is found for you.

label: Add box
description: Adds a box, given by its corner and size. Nothing needs to be selected; new_body 1 keeps it separate, 0 joins it to the model.

label: Add cylinder
description: Adds a cylinder standing on the XY plane at the given position. Nothing needs to be selected; new_body 1 keeps it separate, 0 joins it to the model.

label: Shell
description: Hollows out the solid, leaving the selected faces open. Select the faces to open; the wall thickness grows inward.

label: Mirror
description: Mirrors bodies across a plane and joins the copy. Select bodies in the list (or nothing for the whole model) and optionally one flat face; choose the plane: the selected face, an origin plane, or a picked plane (Pick plane, or a datum plane button); offset moves the plane.

label: Patch fill
description: Closes a gap bounded by selected edges with a smooth filled surface. Needs three or more selected edges forming a closed gap; continuity 1 = tangent to neighbours, 0 = just touching.

label: Bridge edges
description: Joins two edges with a straight-ruled surface. Needs exactly two selected edges.

label: Refine bodies
description: Unify: merges neighbouring faces that lie on the same surface, for example after opening a file made of many small faces. Select bodies (or any face of them) to refine only those, which is much faster on a model with many bodies; with nothing selected every body is refined.

label: Draft
description: Tilts flat faces by an angle so they release from a mold, pivoting about the face centroid (or a picked axis point, or the model's lowest point) along the pull direction (default Z). Select one or more flat faces.

label: Align face
description: Moves the first selected flat face until it is flush with the second, plus an optional offset. Needs exactly two parallel flat faces selected, the one to move first; it stays unavailable until both are selected.

label: Stretch
description: Moves the end faces you select by a distance and re-fits the faces joined to them, so the part gets longer or shorter without cutting. Select the faces at one end; mode 0 re-fits the sides, mode 1 extrudes the end's section.

label: Move/Rotate
description: Moves and turns a whole solid in one step. Drag the arrows (or type distances) to move along X, Y and Z, and drag the rings (or type degrees) to turn about X, Y and Z through the body's centre; the turn is applied first, then the move. Select bodies from the list, any face of the solid, or nothing to move the whole model. With edges selected it moves only the edges (the faces beside them follow): the gizmo sits at the edge middle with two arrows square to the edge and one arc between them that turns the arrows about the edge (Rotate X, which never moves the edge), snapping square to the faces beside the edge. Move X, Y and Z are the edge's world move; Rotate Y and Z are not used.

label: Rotate body
description: Rotates a whole solid about the X, Y or Z axis (0 = X, 1 = Y, 2 = Z): through the origin, or through the body's centre when you select bodies from the list. Select bodies, any face of a solid, or nothing for the whole model.

label: Scale body
description: Scales a whole solid evenly, about the origin or about the body's centre when you select bodies from the list. Select bodies, any face of a solid, or nothing for the whole model; 2 doubles the size.

label: Add sphere
description: Adds a sphere at the given position. Nothing needs to be selected; new_body 1 keeps it separate, 0 joins it to the model.

label: Add cone
description: Adds a cone or truncated cone (set a top diameter of 0 for a point) at the given position. Nothing needs to be selected; new_body 1 keeps it separate, 0 joins it to the model.

label: Add torus
description: Adds a ring shape (donut) at the given position, from the ring radius and the tube radius. Nothing needs to be selected; new_body 1 keeps it separate, 0 joins it to the model.

label: Add prism
description: Adds a prism: a regular polygon (6 sides by default, a hexagon) with a bottom and a top corner-to-corner diameter, standing on the XY plane at the given position. A top diameter of 0 makes a pyramid. Nothing needs to be selected; new_body 1 keeps it separate, 0 joins it to the model.

label: Linear array
description: Makes copies of a body in a grid of columns and rows and fuses them. Select any face of the body, or nothing for the whole model; select only the round walls of holes or bosses to copy just those features; the counts include the original. Set rows to 1 for a single line.

label: Circular array
description: Makes copies of a body (select any of its faces, or nothing for the whole model; select only the round walls of holes or bosses to copy just those features) around the X, Y or Z axis through the origin, or around a picked edge (Pick axis edge), and fuses them. The count includes the original; 360 spreads them round a full circle. Drag the pie-slice grip for the angle (up to 360) and use the mouse wheel over the number on the source for the count.

label: Concentric array
description: Makes copies of a body (select any of its faces, or nothing for the whole model) in rings round the X, Y or Z axis through the origin, or round a picked edge, and fuses them. The first ring passes through the original; each further ring is the radial spacing further out. Count is the positions on the first ring and Extra per ring adds that many to each ring after it. Use the mouse wheel over the numbers on the model for the count, rings and extra, and drag the arrow for the spacing.

label: Revolve face
description: Spins a face around a straight edge to add or cut a round shape. Select one face and one straight edge as the axis; mode 0 adds material, 1 cuts.

label: Chamfer (two distances)
description: Bevels edges with a different distance on each side. Select one face (it sets which side is first) and one or more edges; an edge that does not border that face is measured from its own first neighbouring face.

label: Chamfer (distance and angle)
description: Bevels edges from a distance and an angle: the bevel starts that distance in from the edge along the selected face and slopes away at the angle to that face (45 degrees gives equal legs, a smaller angle a longer, shallower bevel). Select one face (it sets the side the distance is measured on) and one or more of its edges.

label: Boolean
description: Combines solids: Union joins them, Subtract removes the later ones from the first, Intersect keeps only the overlap. Select two or more bodies, or faces of them; the first selected is the target.

label: Variable fillet
description: Rounds edges with a radius that changes along the edge, from the start value at its first end to the end value at its last. Select one or more edges.

label: Fillet per edge
description: Rounds several edges, each with its own radius. Select edges; the form lists one start and end radius per edge, and 0 leaves an edge sharp.

label: Loft between faces
description: Joins two faces with a solid that blends from one outline to the other. Select two faces; ruled 1 gives straight sides, 0 a smooth blend.

label: Sweep face along edge
description: Pulls a face along an edge to make a solid. Select one face and the edge to follow (or Shift-click a kept sketch's curve to follow the whole sketch); mode 0 adds the solid, 1 cuts it.

label: Array along path
description: Needs an edge selected, or a kept sketch chosen with Shift-click on its curve (it does not show in the tool strip otherwise). Places copies of a body at equal distances along connected edges. Select the edges that form the path, plus any face of the body to copy (none copies the whole model), or the round walls of holes or bosses to copy just those features; the count includes the original.

label: Resize fillet
description: Changes the radius of an existing fillet. Select the fillet face (a fillet along a chain of edges is resized as a whole); an end radius of 0 keeps the radius constant.

label: Resize chamfer
description: Changes the size of an existing chamfer, each distance on its own. Select the chamfer face.

label: Cut with plane
description: Cuts the model with a plane and keeps one side or both. Drag the arrow to slide the plane and the two rings to tilt it (tilt_u, tilt_v). Axis 0, 1, 2 is X, Y, Z; axis 3 uses the direction nx, ny, nz. Position is the plane's distance from the origin along its direction. Remove side picks Side 1 (the part on the direction's side), Side 2 (the other part) or None, which keeps both as two separate bodies. Pick plane (a flat face), a datum plane, an origin plane or a sketch button sets the plane from that object. The names of Side 1 and Side 2 take the colours of the bodies they give. Select bodies to cut only those; with nothing selected every body is cut.

label: Split with plane
description: Splits the model into two solids along a plane (axis 0, 1, 2 = X, Y, Z or 3 for the direction nx, ny, nz). Cut with plane does the same with its keep-both choice. Select bodies to cut only those; with nothing selected every body is cut.

label: Offset body
description: Grows (positive) or shrinks (negative) a solid evenly in all directions. Select bodies, any face of the solid, or nothing for the whole model.

label: Round face edges
description: Rounds (positive) or bevels (negative) every edge around the selected faces in one step. Select one or more faces.

label: Inset face edges
description: Draws an inner outline on a flat face, a set distance in from its edges, so that inner area can be pushed, pulled or cut on its own. Select one flat face. Set all_loops to 1 to inset the outer perimeter and every inner profile together; otherwise loop picks one (0 is the outer perimeter).

label: Divide face
description: Adds a dividing line straight across a flat face so each side can be moved on its own. Select one flat face; across picks the direction (0 or 1), offset the position from the centre and angle turns the line by degrees. Set columns and/or rows above 1 to divide the face into an even grid instead.

label: Edit hole
description: Changes a round hole's diameter or depth and moves it, keeping counterbore or countersink steps. Select a face of the hole or the circle at its opening; 0 leaves a size unchanged, and a depth as long as the body is through. Step depth sets how deep the counterbore or countersink at the opening goes (the far end's has End step depth).

label: Edit cut
description: Moves, resizes and sets the depth of a square, slot or other straight-walled cut that goes through the body or ends at a flat floor. Select one wall or the floor of the cut. Resize grows (or, negative, shrinks) every wall by that distance; Length and Width resize move only the two ends along the longer or the shorter side of the cut (square to a world axis); 0 leaves a depth unchanged, and a depth as long as the body is through.

label: Add countersink to hole
description: Adds a countersink to an existing round hole: turns its opening into a cone for a flat-head screw, set by the cone's diameter at the surface and its included angle. Select a face of the hole or the circle at its opening. End 0 is the opening, end 1 the far end of a through hole. This is not the same as an edge chamfer, which is a plain edge break.

label: Add counterbore to hole
description: Adds a counterbore to an existing round hole: widens its opening into a flat-bottomed step for a bolt head, set by the step's diameter and depth. Select a face of the hole or the circle at its opening. End 0 is the opening, end 1 the far end of a through hole.
